## What this changes

A sentence or two. Link the issue it closes: `Closes #123`.

## Why

The problem being solved, or the behaviour that was wrong.

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] A test covers the change, and fails without it
- [ ] A new prop carries a doc comment, so it reaches the API reference
- [ ] No new runtime dependency in `src/`

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything worth knowing: a trade-off you made, a case you deliberately left out,
a measurement that backs a performance claim.
